name: Hudson & West - Woodworking, Hardware & Tool Store
old_description: Discover our extensive selection of premium hardwoods and sheet goods, including domestic and exotic
about:
Hudson & West operates a woodworking supply store in Meridian, Idaho, at 1250 East Kalispell Street. The business serves the Treasure Valley region from a single retail location. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in public sources.

The company stocks a broad inventory of hardwoods and sheet goods, including domestic and exotic hardwoods, softwoods, plywood, mouldings, drawer sides, and veneers. It also carries professional-grade finishes and hardware from brands such as Mohawk, Old Masters, System Three, West Systems, Blum, Häfele, and Sugatsune. Power and hand tools from manufacturers like Festool, SawStop, Shaper Origin, and Bessey round out the offering. The store caters to both professional woodworkers and DIY enthusiasts.

Customers come from the professional woodworking trade and the hobbyist market. The company does not specify additional industries beyond woodworking and related crafts.

Hudson & West emphasizes access to trusted brands and quality materials for woodworking projects. The company does not publish a distinct founding mission or differentiator beyond its product selection.
